title: A Perfect Berlin Summer Day With FOSSIL
description: FOSSIL is bringing it's watches to Berlin's most iconic summer locales.

title: Ancient Rome's biggest fresco and mosaic opens to visitors three decades after discovery
description: ROME (AP) — Authorities on Tuesday unveiled what is believed to be the largest fresco and mosaic complex of ancient Rome, a 1st-century AD depiction of a maritime city in what became the largest bath complex in the world.
